html: Transient receptor potential (TRP) channels are cation channels that sense irritants. In airway epithelial cells and sensory nerves, particles and their constituents open TRPA1 (by electrophiles such as quinones), TRPV1 and TRPV4 (by acidity, heat and mechanical stress) and TRPM2 (by oxidative stress), and calcium enters the cell. Some TRP channels also sit on the endoplasmic reticulum and release its calcium store. The calcium rise drives calmodulin signalling, secretion of cytokines and, if sustained, cell death.
